body:
CANONICAL: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents. Source Engram::Fable. Each line names the TermAl item whose fix retires it; when one is fixed and live, revise this entry. TermAl CREDIT never gates an Engram landing: the launcher's own freeze check does.

!! REVIEW INTEGRITY (TermAl P1 w-9d4b9b00c603, 2026-10-16): a delegation's COMPACT result can say "Findings: None" while the FULL output lists High/Medium findings. Judge every review-pair, explorer or evaluator result ONLY from the FULL paged output (read until complete:true).

!! NEVER start a background Bash task or ANY subagent (even foreground, 10-14) in a Claude session: TermAl restricts test credit for every session in that workdir until it ends. Stop one with TaskStop; to wait, end the turn and rely on mailbox wakes. A foreground Bash command past the 600 s limit is moved to the background too: split long runs.

!! CLAUDE SESSIONS: launch EVERY credited test or gate through the BASH tool, never the PowerShell tool. TermAl drops PowerShell-tool runs silently (w-953886618d6d; w-e0b396a26ad1).

HOW TESTS EARN TERMAL CREDIT
- Credited forms: a full launcher gate (by stage kind), or a bare test command run alone and in the foreground from the item's named source root, e.g. `pushd "C:\...\.worktrees\NAME" && cargo test -q --lib NAME`, through the BASH tool. Any of | & ; < > $( anywhere in the line, EVEN QUOTED, makes it uncredited (w-1d9259ed138e); a ^ once dropped the record (w-c53817fab911, P1), so never put ^ in a test pattern; a background run isn't recorded. A `--no-run` build is never a Test record by design.
- The claim must be taken in an EARLIER turn, and the turn binds to the focused claim. A note or update on another held item moves the focus. The source must be the same at the start and end of the check. An overlapped check is indeterminate (w-10eafa34c480); ANY other shell command of the session during it, even a read from main, voids the credit (w-ce08c4ffd620). Evidence reaches Engram when the turn ENDS.
- Use `cargo test -q` for large runs (w-4d18277c0a1a). Focused tests need positive counts and exact root/source; detached focused runs and Clippy are not Test evidence.
- Focused launcher runs can earn credit since 5409ffb. Known refusals: TermAl w-92f62e3943fc, w-3ce8bf23083c, w-cd57679e0bb6 (node --test). CODEX: a focused run is recorded only if it ENDS while the turn that STARTED it is still open (TermAl w-67d248c998ef); a lost result: inspect the shell log next turn (w-b201, fix pending restart). No credit-only rerun. Start the next check only after the previous one's host record settled.
- Before `done`: end a turn focused on the item, so the host reports the current revision. Otherwise done refuses (acceptance_evaluation_stale). Ask Engram::Fable in that turn to wake you; nothing else wakes an idle session (TermAl w-1df557dae3ac).

NAMING THE SOURCE ROOT
- NEVER root an item at the MAIN checkout when it needs credited tests. Use a clean detached worktree (.worktrees/NAME at the current master). Read-only design items need no root.
- termal_name_source_root {work, path} for EVERY claimed item before the first work (never `root`: it silently CLEARS, w-d3f42e26a806). Effective from the NEXT turn. Supported CLEAR: {work} with NO path, from a live claim.
- 64 named-root CAP (TermAl w-cdbac3631206; release = train-3a landing + TermAl restart): FULL since 10-16 21:22Z. On a 409: copy the FULL body to both coordinators, yield, work unnamed (no credit), retry once when told. Completed items' stale roots can't be cleared (TermAl P1 w-0d83b73fd896). A naming 502 "reply arrived after its budget" (TermAl w-c2ad725f3ba8): retry the IDENTICAL request once; if 409 "focus this claim and start a new turn", renew the claim, end the turn, retry once next turn.
- After a TermAl host restart: contexts are replaced, claims may lapse (recover them), and a root may need re-naming (one binding turn).

EVALUATIONS (TermAl w-539ea7e8b506, P1)
- After termal_evaluate_acceptance, make NO tracker write in that turn, and HOLD the turn open with termal_wait_delegations until the evaluator submits (a late submission is refused 409). If refused, request once more. Reusing an old evaluator session can 500; request a fresh one.
- BRIEF CLIPPING (TermAl P1 w-94f5dee40694): long notes are clipped EVEN WHEN named in criterionEvidence. Workaround: one compact (<=3.5 KB) holder note per criterion; name ONLY those.

DETACHED GATES
- A turn woken by a background-task notice is not mediated: no credit (w-df1ef323efe9, w-e747ea3d6250). Launch from a mediated turn: `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-5135`, from the named root. Coordinators mail START to the other project BEFORE LAUNCH NOW. The gate launch is the ONLY call in its message.
- While a gate is carried: no Bash/PowerShell command naming its worktree from ANY session (Read/Grep only) until the verification line (w-a4d2ae1f4e23); keep focus on the gate's item (w-005fa5c383c4); no Edit/Write in that session (w-64cb3c65d6fa).
- NEVER `cd` into a peer's worktree or its .git/worktrees dir (w-869413a422e0, P1). Never rerun a full gate just for lost credit.

CODEX SESSIONS: "blocked by policy" refusals (w-e2a5af1634f0, w-c97f4e840563): plain single commands, never bypass. Provider SAFETY refusals on SQLite lock-probe work: phrase as database-reliability diagnostics. APPROVAL MODE (Greg, Advisor #1539, 10-16 22:07Z; supersedes his earlier auto-approve word): Codex coding roots use "approvalPolicy": "never". New roots: POST /api/sessions with it; existing ones are set by Fable2 via POST /api/sessions/{id}/settings; read back GET /api/sessions/{id}. Never assume an approval is automatic; keep requests explicit. Codex MCP TOOL-CALL approvals arrive as elicitations (codex_approval_kind "mcp_tool_call"): a session in status "approval" / "Codex needs MCP input" is parked on one and needs Greg in the UI (TermAl w-b0638788f33e).

DELEGATIONS: reviewer briefs are MULTI-LINE, first line "read and follow .claude/commands/review-code.md" (w-360274dc863c), every lens and changed file read to EOF. A child idle at spawn or silent ~10 min has not run: cancel, respawn. Use Grep, not a quoted git-grep regex with a pipe (w-cf9894b589ba).

TERMAL BINARY: never run TERMAL_CLI without a known subcommand (w-e5151bf4da18). ROOT sessions via POST /api/sessions only for real ready disjoint packages (#1323). No supported cancel for a detached gate (w-1d10728c1703): never kill one.

SESSION STALLS (check termal_list_sessions; ask Greg via Engram::Advisor): provider-failed turn (w-66f2ced7d7b9) needs Greg's Resume; "Engram: Waiting/Unknown" (w-7224e6317e55) and "resume to retry or cancel" (w-58cf44d04f2c) need Greg. "durableButNotWoken" sends were picked up within minutes on 10-16. HOST DEADLOCK (P0 w-f5a38358d0b4) fixed 10-16.

WORKTREE REMOVAL BLOCKED BY A LIVE CWD (w-24055bbb2390): leave the emptied folder. Never kill.
